title: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: User is registered with a valid email and password, and the account is active and unlocked.
steps: Enter the valid registered email in the email field.
Enter the correct password in the password field.
expected_result: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
expected_result: An error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed, and the user remains on the login page.

title: Validation warning when both email and password fields are empty
preconditions: User is on the login page.
expected_result: Validation warnings are displayed indicating that both email and password fields are required.

title: Validation warning when password field is empty
preconditions: User is on the login page.
expected_result: A validation warning is displayed indicating that the password field is required.

title: Account locking after three consecutive failed login attempts
preconditions: User is registered and the account is currently unlocked.
steps: Enter valid email and incorrect password, then click login (Attempt 1).
Enter valid email and incorrect password, then click login (Attempt 2).
Enter valid email and incorrect password, then click login (Attempt 3).
expected_result: On the third failed attempt, the account is locked and an error message is displayed indicating the account is locked.

title: Login attempt with valid credentials on a locked account
preconditions: User account is locked due to three consecutive failed login attempts.
expected_result: Login fails, and an error message is displayed indicating that the account is locked.
